name: @hydra/dsh-fleet-budget
description: Prototype: the V3 fleet budget (cost tracking + scoped caps + soft warnings + escalation, owner decision #4) — per-identity / per-task-kind / global budgets with a soft-warning threshold (default 80% of the cap) that emits fleet/budget-warning and an escalation threshold (default 100%) that emits fleet/budget-escalated to the named owner. Durable SQLite store; the checkWake(agentId) scheduler-consult seam satisfies the fleet-supervisor's FleetBudgetLike interface (live wiring is a documented follow-up). Registers ctx.fleetBudget + the budget_set / budget_record / budget_status tools. Issue #26.
